summary: TRACK-B-STUCK-01 follow-up, prospective only. carbon/battery/value/real_divergence.py splits each score-value divergence condition into constructed-control, within-family and across-family real-model pairs. Classed totals equal every frozen study's committed counts; nothing is rescored. EV4 verification: the deciding rule has 1 across-family real divergence (plus 4 within-family, 2 control). The SR-2 and SR-3 margin-aware candidates have 5 and 6, so they make real-model divergence worse, which supports keeping the deciding rule. The localized sign-error control outranks 95-98 of 99 real members under every rule; no rule or mean-optimism gate catches it, so it needs its own measurement (a science decision). Recommendation: EV5 pre-registers across-family real-member divergence as its criterion.
